title: XALIGN: A Human-centric Visual Analytics Approach to Understanding AI Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2610.31015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) methods are usually evaluated for technical properties such as faithfulness and robustness. In high-stakes application domains, experts also need to check model predictions against established knowledge. Different explanation methods often disagree, and this disagreement is hard to see when each method is inspected separately. We propose XALIGN, a visual analytics workflow and interface that shows rule-based explanations and several feature attribution methods (TreeSHAP, KernelSHAP, and LIME) side by side for the same Random Forest model. Agreements and contradictions between the methods become visible signals that users can explore and compare with domain knowledge. We apply XALIGN in two case studies: the German Credit dataset and a meteorological dataset, in which events derived from ICON model output and Cloudnet observations are classified. translated_title: XALIGN：一种以人为中心的理解AI解释的可视化分析方法
translated_abstract: 可解释AI（XAI）方法通常根据忠实性和鲁棒性等技术特性进行评估。在高风险应用领域，专家还需要对照既有知识来核验模型预测。不同的解释方法之间常常存在分歧，而当单独检查每种方法时，这种分歧难以察觉。我们提出了XALIGN，这是一个可视化分析工作流和界面，能够并排展示针对同一随机森林模型的基于规则的解释以及多种特征归因方法（TreeSHAP、KernelSHAP和LIME）。各方法之间的一致与矛盾成为可见的信号，用户可以据此进行探索并与领域知识进行对比。我们在两个案例研究中应用了XALIGN：德国信贷数据集和一个气象数据集，后者对来自ICON模型输出和Cloudnet观测的事件进行分类。在这两个案例中，相关视图揭示了基于规则的解释（原文此处截断）
tldr: XALIGN通过并排展示同一随机森林模型的基于规则的解释与多种特征归因方法（TreeSHAP、KernelSHAP、LIME），使用户能够直观发现各解释方法之间的一致与矛盾，并结合领域知识核验模型预测。
en_tdlr: XALIGN is a human-centric visual analytics approach that displays rule-based explanations and multiple feature attribution methods (TreeSHAP, KernelSHAP, LIME) side by side for the same Random Forest model, enabling users to visually detect agreements and contradictions among explanation methods and verify model predictions against domain knowledge.
